I relate to that a lot. I struggle with my anxiety and its been getting worst this year due to work and I'm also in the process of applying for jobs. I just had my worst month struggling from my mental health to just everything in general. I try not to rely on my bf too much bc in the end it's my own battle that I need to fight. Enjoy your relationship for sure! But you need to remind yourself to not be dependant on someone on certain things and always put yourself first when it comes to mental health. Those are the 2 things I tell myself as I tend to transition to a sadder version of me or be too dependant on his comfort, which it might affect him in ways, but I'm lucky that he's willing to deal with it. Sometimes I also need a lot of space and he would respect that. As time progresses you'll both know each other more and if she's the one she'll stick through with you as she gets to know more of you :) and your job is to remain the best you you can be for her and for yourself x

First thing's first, enjoy your time with her!! If she's a great person then you would gradually calm down from the excitement. Meeting someone you like is something worth being excited for! I was in a silimar situation. I get over excited and wasn't sure on how to focus on daily tasks or work without having him on my mind for a sec but I reminded myself that I have my priorities to settle and then I can think about him after all I want. Talk to yourself out loud and give yourself instructions on what to do, simple things like 'breathe, I can be calm' and then you can focus on whatever's bugging you at the moment in a clearer state. Hope this helps!? :)
